name: Sarah Stokely
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Sarah Stokely (Choosing Change) is a neurodiversity-affirming Counsellor with a special interest in ADHD and autism. Sarah works from a trauma-informed and neurodiversity-affirming approach. In addition to her formal training, Sarah also values her lived experience of the personal and family impacts of mental ill-health, late diagnosed neurodiversity, trauma and addiction.

name: Meghan Tozer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a qualified counsellor, working in both the in-room counselling space and with equine assisted therapy. Helping people express themselves through connection with horses, I use animal assisted therapy to help adolescents, children and adults navigate anxiety, social anxiety, self-esteem and confidence issues, life transitioning, parenting stresses, grief and loss and trauma.

name: Rachel Kleinman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I believe that creating a safe, supportive space for therapy can allow for the exploration of life struggles, painful events and relationship issues, eventually creating the powerful potential for healing and change in people’s lives. I have specialist experience and interest in working with grief and loss. I have worked extensively with families grieving the death of a baby or child.

name: Karen Thomas
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
practice: Karen Sri Thomas Counselling & Psychotherapy, (Hummingbird Therapy)
description: Your concerns might relate to anxiety, depression, relationship difficulties, grief at the loss of a loved one or a job, or low self-esteem. Alternatively, you're a survivor of family domestic abuse wanting to move through your trauma and heal. Together, we'll identify your best ways of releasing the burdens of stress, tension, and past trauma in your healing journey in ways that are unique to you. Within the counselling process and in conjunction with my diverse cultural background and my trauma-informed, integrative approaches, I have witnessed many clients over many sessions experience shifts and ultimately relief as they release these burdens experientially.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Rachel Durrant
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: CuriousNeuro Counselling was born from both professional expertise and lived experience. Founded by Rachel, who was diagnosed with ADHD at 39 years young, we specialise in empowering adults who have received a later-in-life neurodevelopmental diagnosis. We provide 100% online telehealth counselling aimed at helping individuals embrace their neurodiversity and navigate the life changes and challenges that come with it.
